Loadouts are premade, map is Island Chaos, and is 12 waves|In-game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Classic Island Chaos''' is the fourth challenge [[Maps|map]] of [[The Classic Event]]. It has been made available again through the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. Like other event maps, this map has a specialized wave structure with special enemies. Triumphing this map rewarded the player with {{Token|1}}. There was also {{Tix|1}} on the map, which could be found behind the enemy exit. This map has a premade loadout. It consists of the [[Warden]], [[Golden Soldier]], [[Commander]], [[Pursuit]] and [[Minigunner]]. Golden perks and skins could not be applied to these towers without the use of bugs, though this is not the case in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. This map had four modifiers. The first was [[Enemies Beta]], which changed the appearance of some enemies. The second was [[Classic Roblox]], which activated the next two modifiers on the map. The third modifier was [[Classic Oof]], which made enemies play the old Roblox death sound. The fourth was [[Retro Death]], which made enemies collapse into multiple pieces upon death. When activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only [[Classic Oof]] and [[Retro Death]] are applied. ==Design & Path== '''Classic Island Chaos''' takes place on a sandy island in the middle of the ocean. Small patches of grass can be seen on the ground, which have palm trees growing on them. Multiple stone mounts can be found on the map, which act as cliff spaces. There are also a few wooden beach huts and red crabs on the map. The black path starts and ends at two grassy caves with the path weaving around grassy mounds. The map slowly corrupted itself, turning parts of the map into a dark black color, and making other objects float in the sky. By Wave 6, the skybox was slowly changing to storm clouds, and rain began to fall down. By Wave 7, yellow lightning bolts struck down on the map. This no longer happens in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Classic Island Chaos}} ==Event Rewards== The game calculated how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 100% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned was multiplied by 2x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplied any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. Any rewards that ended in a decimal point were rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. Rewards were calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" !Coins Reward !EXP Reward |- |({{Coins|100}} ÷ (1 + [(14 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|100}} (Triumph Only)) × 1.3 |({{Exp|30}} ÷ (1 + [(14 ÷ Current Wave) - 1])) × 1.3 |} ===Badges=== There were also a few [[badges]] which could be obtained when playing this map, which may have had additional rewards alongside the [[Badges|badge]]. These were: {{Badge |title = Premium 4 |image = PremiumBadge.png |obtainable = No |rewards = {{Token|1}} }} {{Badge |title = Tix 4 |image = TixBadge.png |obtainable = No |rewards = {{Tix|1}} }} ==Wave Structure== Wave bonus is calculated as: :{{Money|100}} + (Waves Completed × {{Money|1,350}})^0.99 Wave clear bonus is 35% of the wave bonus. '''Bolded''' names indicates an enemy type's debut.

==Strategy== *Early on, the [[Golden Soldier]] can be quite effective at clearing out hordes of enemies. *Later on, the [[Minigunner]] and [[Pursuit]] can clear out hordes of enemies quite easily. **Do note that the [[Pursuit]] does not have hidden detection. *The [[Commander]] can be useful at boosting the firerate of your towers. *You can use the [[Warden]] to slow down enemies that appear on this map, though this is not necessary. ==Trivia== *This map is based on [[Island Chaos]], an old and now removed map. *[[1x1x1x1]]'s comment, "''I don't like sand. Its coarse and rough and irritating and it gets everywhere''", is a direct reference to an infamous line said by [[w:c:starwars:Anakin Skywalker|Anakin]] in ''Star Wars: Attack of the Clones''. ==Update History== *'''23 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0]] **'''Classic Island Chaos''' added. **{{Bug}} Towers can have other skins if the tower is equipped in the lobby. *'''28 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0|v1.23.3]] **'''Classic Island Chaos''' removed. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Classic Island Chaos''' re-added, to [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode only. **{{Bug}} Wave structure turns into regular modes after the final wave. **{{Bug}} {{Tix|}} no longer spins. **{{Bug}} Map no longer corrupts. **{{Bug}} [[1x1x1x1]] no longer has a model. {{TheClassicMaps|[[Classic Forest Camp]]|Mission 3|[[Classic Island Chaos]]|Mission 4|[[Classic Castle]]|Mission 5}} {{MapNavBox}} [[Category:Sandbox Only Maps]]
